name: WalkMyPlan — AI Home Design & 3D Floor Plans
description:
Describe the home you want — "two kids' bedrooms, a master bedroom with its own bathroom, a guest bathroom, an open kitchen and dining room, and a garden" — and Claude designs the floor plan, then WalkMyPlan builds it in one call: real walls, doors, windows, named rooms, furniture and garden trees, even a pool. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.

No architect vocabulary needed — say it the way you'd say it out loud. Want an L-shape, a courtyard or a covered patio? Those work too.

The link opens the house in 3D, and a Sketch button flips it to the editable 2D plan — drag walls, move doors, redraw a room by hand, and the 3D updates.

Or just say what you want changed. "Make the living room bigger." "Put a TV on the north wall." Every room carries a number on the plan and a compass marks north, so "widen room 3" lands exactly — or drop a pin in the viewer and say "put the front door there". Furniture placement is automatic: it finds a free spot, away from doorways. Every edit lands in a revision history you can undo or roll back to any point. Edits are for visualization and planning; WalkMyPlan does not check structural safety or building codes.

Ask about what you built. "How big is the kitchen?", "Is there room for a double bed in the small bedroom?" Answers are measured from the model's real geometry.

Share a plan privately with named people as viewers or editors, or with a link. See who changed what, when.

Already have a floor plan? The same private link takes your architect's DWG or vector PDF, up to 100MB, and converts it into the same editable, walkable 3D model.

Great for home design, interior design, room planning, renovation, and planning a build. Your plans stay private to your account unless you share them, are never used to train AI models, and can be deleted any time (trash keeps them recoverable for 30 days).

Try: "Build me a three-bedroom house with a master bedroom, a guest bathroom and a garden" — then "walk me through it."

_published_faq.name: How do I add WalkMyPlan — AI Home Design & 3D Floor Plans to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add WalkMyPlan — AI Home Design & 3D Floor Plans to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.walkmyplan.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the WalkMyPlan — AI Home Design & 3D Floor Plans MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: WalkMyPlan — AI Home Design & 3D Floor Plans lists 40 MCP tools, including create_plan_from_url, delete_plan, get_plan_link, get_plan_status, get_sharing, list_my_plans, list_revisions, rename_plan, restore_revision, set_sharing, undo_last_edit, and get_plan_structure.
